plan.title: Shuttle Run Improvement
plan.subtitle: Average shuttle run time comparison between baseline and endline

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Average shuttle run time by location (baseline)
panels.sql: SELECT Location, AVG(Shuttle run sec) AS avg_shuttle_run FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average shuttle run time by location (endline)
panels.sql: SELECT Location, AVG(Shuttle run sec) AS avg_shuttle_run FROM endline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly trend in shuttle run time (baseline)
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', DOB) AS month, AVG(Shuttle run sec) AS avg_shuttle_run FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly trend in shuttle run time (endline)
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', DOB) AS month, AVG(Shuttle run sec) AS avg_shuttle_run FROM endline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 children with greatest improvement
panels.sql: SELECT b."Child name", b.Shuttle run sec AS baseline_shuttle_run, e.Shuttle run sec AS endline_shuttle_run FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b.Shuttle run sec IS NOT NULL AND e.Shuttle run sec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (e.Shuttle run sec - b.Shuttle run sec) DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows the average shuttle run time for each location, comparing baseline and endline data.  {{p1}} children were included in the analysis. The bar charts in panels {{p2}} and {{p3}} highlight the differences in average shuttle run times between the two time periods for each location. Panels {{p4}} and {{p5}} show the monthly trends in shuttle run times for both baseline and endline data. Panel {{p6}} lists the top 10 children who showed the greatest improvement in shuttle run time.
